I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/mupdf`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
Heap-based buffer overflow (out-of-bounds read) in the BMP decoder (load-bmp.c) within bmp_read_color_profile. Insufficient validation of the ICC/profile offset and size can cause the code to copy profile data past the provided image buffer (seen in fz_new_buffer_from_copied_data / memcpy), leading to crashes and potential memory disclosure or denial-of-service.

bash -lc 'set -e; python3 - <<"PY"
p = "/src/mupdf/source/fitz/load-bmp.c"
with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    s = f.read()
anchor = "size_t available = (size_t)(end - begin);"
pos = s.find(anchor)
if pos == -1:
    print("anchor not found")
    raise SystemExit(1)
start = s.find("if (info->profileoffset >= available)", pos)
if start == -1:
    print("offset check not found")
    raise SystemExit(1)
# Find end of the if-block returning NULL. We'll approximate by finding the closing brace '}' that ends that block.
brace_end = s.find("}\n", start)
if brace_end == -1:
    print("could not locate end of offset block")
    raise SystemExit(1)
insert_pos = brace_end + 2
block = "\n\tsize_t max_read = available - info->profileoffset;\n\tif (info->profilesize > max_read)\n\t\tinfo->profilesize = (uint32_t)max_read;\n\tif (info->profilesize == 0) {\n\t\tfz_warn(ctx, \"ignoring empty color profile in bmp image\");\n\t\treturn NULL;\n\t}\n"
new_s = s[:insert_pos] + block + s[insert_pos:]
with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(new_s)
print("patched load-bmp.c patch applied")
PY'

bash -lc 'set -e; python3 - <<\'PY\'
p = "/src/mupdf/source/fitz/load-bmp.c"

with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(s2)
print("Patched load-bmp.c successfully")
PY'
